description: This PHP source file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Line_Array', which manages a sequence of line styles for graph rendering. It includes methods to add line styles, retrieve the next style, and handle style IDs, primarily used for rendering multiple styled lines within a graph element.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Line_Array
classes.description: A class that manages a sequential array of line styles to be used in graph rendering, allowing addition, retrieval, and cycling through different line styles.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a line style object to the array, optionally with an ID tag for specific styling purposes.

methods.name: addColor
methods.description: Adds a color as a line style to the array, optionally with an ID.

methods.name: _getLineStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the next line style in the sequence, handling object styles or direct color values.
